I couldn't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest, so nothing is scheduled.

A recurring post to this channel would need an admin to set it up through the Slack integration.

I can post the "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand whenever Bettina asks. I haven't posted any digest or read the channel contents for it yet.
